editorial_basis: Definitions and interpretation of existing published RamyAura passages; separate from transcript wording.
review_scope: Curated examples only; incomplete across the corpus. New daily uploads are not automatically annotated.

concepts.label: Map tempo
concepts.definition: Relative readiness for the next useful action, including readiness alongside allies.

concepts.label: Recall / reset action
concepts.definition: The lane/map action of returning to base to recover resources and spend gold. Other kinds of resets are separate senses.

concepts.label: Recall window
concepts.definition: An opportunity to recall at an acceptable cost in farm or pressure.

concepts.label: Lane priority
concepts.definition: The practical ability to act or move before the opposing laner in the current situation.

concepts.label: Lane control
concepts.definition: Influence over the wave state; holding a freeze and choosing to push are different uses of that control.

concepts.label: Short trade
concepts.definition: An exchange with a planned early disengagement; duration alone does not establish the damage cost.

concepts.label: One-sided trade
concepts.definition: Damage delivered with little or no return damage; not necessarily a full-health kill.

concepts.label: All-in
concepts.definition: Committing to finish the opponent, with available cooldowns and summoners affecting the decision.

concepts.label: Sustain and trade value
concepts.definition: Recovery and the next reset affect whether a damage exchange leaves a useful advantage. These are editorial lookup labels.

concepts.label: Shadowing an ally
concepts.definition: Positioning to support an ally’s likely action. Interface hover, lane-side positioning and item-passive names are different senses.

concepts.label: Team timing
concepts.definition: Editorial label for acting during compatible windows with teammates; not a claim that Ramy uses each alias.

concepts.label: Overstay
concepts.definition: Spending extra time on the map at the cost of a better next action or reset. The examples include decisions to avoid that cost.

concepts.label: Spacing
concepts.definition: Managing distance relative to available threats and tools. Tethering is an editorial lookup alias.

concepts.label: Weakside
concepts.definition: The side with less allied support in the situation; not simply a losing duel.

concepts.label: Strongside
concepts.definition: The side receiving greater allied support in the situation.

concepts.label: Slow push
concepts.definition: Allowing the wave to build while it advances rather than clearing it immediately.

concepts.label: Crash
concepts.definition: A completed crash puts surviving minions under the enemy turret. Shoving is the pushing action and does not guarantee the crash.

concepts.label: Bounce
concepts.definition: The wave begins pushing back after a crash.

concepts.label: Cheater recall
concepts.definition: An early recall made affordable by the wave state; specific purchase and wave timing depend on the game.

concepts.label: Lethal Tempo rune
concepts.definition: A rune name in the recordings; its shared word does not make it map-tempo evidence.

concepts.label: Fast push / shove
concepts.definition: Clearing the enemy wave quickly. This pushing action does not guarantee that surviving minions complete a crash.
